features.name: any_comment_mentions_year
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment mention a specific year?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as JSON list of strings (null if missing/malformed; empty list -> 0). Return 1 if any comment matches regex r'\b(1[0-9]{3}|20[0-9]{2})\b' (four-digit years 1000-2099, case-insensitive, also matches inside e.g. '1990s'; no semantic filtering), else 0. Raw text may include outcome announcements; no filtering applied.

features.name: count_comments_mentioning_year
features.definition: How many counter-argument comments mention a specific year?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as JSON list of strings (null if missing/malformed; empty list -> 0). Count comments matching regex r'\b(1[0-9]{3}|20[0-9]{2})\b'. Raw mechanical count; no semantic filtering.

h0: any_comment_mentions_year has no association with the probability that the OP changed their view.
h1: Rows where any counter-argument comment mentions a specific year have a higher probability of OP view change.
note: Year mention is a literal proxy for historical/empirical grounding; it does not verify that the year is used as evidence (e.g., could be a date reference or unrelated). Persuasiveness operationalized as delta; association only. Comment order/timing unknown; text may contain outcome announcements and was not filtered. A count version is also provided as an alternative intensity measure.
